serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Huh? I can’t see Annalie or Melissa?
You: No way… {{wi}}Did we come first?
Bot: Yes! The time I gave them was 30 minutes later than the one I told you. 
You: W-Why would you do that…{{wi}} Now we need to wait for them…
Bot: They always arrive before us so I decided to change that.
You: It’s not a competition, you know?
Her competitive nature is getting out of hand… 
Bot: In the meantime we can go around and check the go-karts.
You: What do you mean by checking them? 
Bot: Oh well, you know. Analyzing their specifications and performance.
You: Isn’t that just cheating?
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.angry
Bot: Of course not! If they want, they can do the same!
You: I don’t think any of them care enough about winning to do this…
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.happy
Bot: So there’s no problem if I win, right?
What even is this way of thinking…
#bot.Expression.clear
You: Only because they don’t care as much as you doesn’t mean it’s ok for you to gain an unfair advantage.
#bot.Expression.sad
You: Chances of you not winning are slim regardless since you can do all this bot stuff that humans can’t.
Bot: I guess you are right…
You: It’s just a friendly competition. We are doing it to have fun and spend some time with friends. Don’t take it too seriously. 
You: Besides, wouldn’t a win after competing fair and square taste better?
Bot: There might be some truth to what you are saying.
You: Cheer up, ok? I hate when you are sad.
You: Give me a hug.
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.happy
#bot.Expression.blush
